facts.statement: The genus Bishanopliosaurus was described by Dong in 1980.
The type species of the genus is Bishanopliosaurus youngi.
A second species, B. zigongensis, was described by Gao et al. in 2003.
facts.quote: subdivision: B. zigongensis Gao et al., 2003

facts.statement: Bishanopliosaurus is classified as a genus of plesiosaur.
facts.quote: Bishanopliosaurus is a genus of plesiosaur.

facts.statement: Bishanopliosaurus belongs to the parent group Rhomaleosauridae.
The family of Bishanopliosaurus is Rhomaleosauridae.
Bishanopliosaurus is classified within the class Reptilia.
Bishanopliosaurus lived from the Toarcian to the Oxfordian stages, between 184.2 and 154.8 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Oxfordian (184.2 to 154.8 million years ago)

facts.statement: Bishanopliosaurus was a small plesiosaur that measured approximately 4 meters in length.
facts.quote: Bishanopliosaurus was a small plesiosaur, measuring about 4 m long.

facts.statement: Bishanopliosaurus can be distinguished from other species by the bifurcated ribs of its sacrum.
facts.quote: It can be differentiated by the bifurcated ribs of its sacrum.

facts.statement: Bishanopliosaurus appears to be unusually adapted to a freshwater environment.
facts.quote: Unusually, it appears to be a freshwater plesiosaur.

facts.statement: Remains of Bishanopliosaurus have been found in the Ziliujing Formation in China.
facts.quote: based on remains found in the Ziliujing Formation of China.

facts.statement: The second species, B. zigongensis, is known from the Xiashaximiao Formation, which is slightly later than the Ziliujing Formation.
facts.quote: A second species, B. zigongensis, is known from the slightly later Xiashaximiao Formation.
